parsed.rationale: Both `WXUISampleApp.body` (in `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift`) and `PlayerHeaderViewApp.body` (in `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift`) are SwiftUI `App`-conforming entry-point `body` computed properties. These are boilerplate entry points required by the SwiftUI `App` protocol for each preview/sample application target; their structural identity at line 15 is a coincidence of the protocol requirement, not shared domain logic. The two types belong to different packages (`WXUI` and `PlayerHeaderView`) and serve as independent app harnesses for their respective UI components. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated component preview targets and provide no meaningful reuse.
